# Management repository operation

Read the frozen batch and phase guidance via `session_context`. Cover every source and its Kanban commit context; preserve unrelated files and submodule checkouts.

Analyze first. Automatic mode admits conflict-free integration through the host's frozen approval; real conflicts need selected resolutions. Use source and target as the option IDs for whole-file decisions. For a custom choice, prepare only the selected path and report the blob resolution through the structured channel. Preserve target and source worktrees and indexes. The host refreshes stale analysis, publishes verified resolutions and supplies the actual targetHead. Ask only for unresolved choices or additional authority.

Build, replacement, acceptance and cleanup retain their own host receipts.
